_doc: BBB-tier (and lower IG) hospital muni obligor universe for covenant tripwire screening
_purpose: AA-tier pilot was all-green due to massive covenant headroom; this universe targets credits where covenant compliance is genuinely close
_methodology: Web search via Becker's Hospital Review, Bond Buyer, Modern Healthcare, S&P/Moody's/Fitch press releases. Rating dates noted where findable. Ratings drift fast at this tier — verify in EMMA before live signal use.
_rating_definition: IG floor = Baa3 (Moody's) / BBB- (S&P/Fitch). All entries below have at least one rating in BBB+/BBB/BBB- (S&P/Fitch) or Baa1/Baa2/Baa3 (Moody's) as of 2024-2025 disclosures.

obligors.notes: Downgrade tied to ~31% leverage increase from acquiring 2 Tenet hospitals (~$750M new debt). Strong candidate for covenant tripwire — leverage step-up and integration risk are exactly the failure modes the signal targets.

_disclosure_quality_observations.pattern_1: Larger systems (Adventist Health, Brown/Lifespan, Mount Sinai) all maintain dedicated IR pages with quarterly MDA filings — easy to scrape. EMMA also reliable.
_disclosure_quality_observations.pattern_2: Smaller standalones (Frederick Health, Hurley, Lompoc, Mosaic) often only file on EMMA — no separate IR page. Must search by conduit issuer name + obligor.
_disclosure_quality_observations.pattern_3: Sub-IG names (Tower Health, ProMedica, Cabell Huntington) tend to have MORE material event notices on EMMA — rating changes, forbearance, distressed exchanges. Signal-rich.
_disclosure_quality_observations.pattern_4: Group-rated obligors (AHN under Highmark) are a STRUCTURAL HAZARD for the screen — agency rating reflects parent support, but covenant compliance is calculated on obligated-group financials alone. The signal MUST use obligated-group-only metrics, not consolidated parent. AHN standalone is BBB-tier even though S&P stamps it 'A'.
_disclosure_quality_observations.pattern_5: Fitch is typically the most aggressive downgrader (Adventist Health, UofL, Frederick all downgraded by Fitch first). Moody's often lags by 3-9 months. Watch Fitch for early signal.
_disclosure_quality_observations.pattern_6: Several 2024-2025 downgrades cite EXPLICIT covenant breach risk in rating commentary (Cabell Huntington DCOH, OU Medicine liquidity). This is gold for backtest labeling — treat these as confirmed-true positives.

_signal_design_notes.must_use: Obligated-group financials, not parent-consolidated. AHN is the canonical trap.
_signal_design_notes.rating_drift_risk: Ratings at this tier move 1-2 notches per year. Re-verify quarterly.
_signal_design_notes.exclusion_candidates: Tower Health, ProMedica, Cabell Huntington are now sub-IG. Keep them in universe ONLY as labeled positive training examples; do not score for 'live' signal.
_signal_design_notes.negative_controls: Saint Peter's NJ (Baa2 positive outlook), Hurley Medical Center (Baa3 just-upgraded) — these should NOT trigger covenant tripwire. Use as false-positive checks.
